description.content: The new Aperture-Pin mark now shows in the left navigation rail too. The "Machines & Files" item still carried the old monitor glyph — it now matches the title bar and the app icon.
The rail icon follows the navigation's selected/rest colors instead of a fixed accent, so it looks right whether the item is active or not.
No functional changes — this finishes the visual icon refresh started in 1.3.1.
